topics.title: How to Complete Pipework in GTA 6
topics.summary: Finish Pipework in GTA 6 by grabbing the plunger beside Mandy's bathroom toilet, then using it and the wrench at her kitchen sink.

topics.title: How to Complete Get Shirley's Rum in GTA 6
topics.summary: Find Shirley near Jason's house in Key Lento, collect her bottle from Three Sheets Liquor, and bring it back before you move on with the story.

topics.title: How to Complete Steal the Scooter in GTA 6
topics.summary: Return to Shirley after the rum errand, take Peggy's mobility scooter from beside her stairs, and park it inside Shirley's screened porch.
